snippet.title: Trench Tales - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: A story-driven third-person action game set in a dark, alternative world between WWI and WWII. Harness unique powers, customize your arsenal, and navigate haunting Gothic landscapes. Battle fallen soldiers as you uncover the mysteries of this realm.
